theme_and_archetype.vibe: Intelligence brief, classified dossier, campaign file, typewriter accents, physical paper forms, confident and practical.

do: Make it look like a printed document
dont: No fake testimonials or logo bars

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Form/Bento hybrid. Use CSS grid with border-collapse effects. Sections separated by strong horizontal ruled lines (1px solid border-[#1A1A1A]/20).
layout_and_spacing.shadows: None. Rely on 1px borders and high contrast. Background elements can have hard-edged offset blocks (e.g., 4px translate-x, 4px translate-y).

button.primary: rounded-none bg-[#7A2021] text-white px-8 py-4 font-mono text-sm tracking-widest uppercase hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] transition-colors duration-200 border border-transparent
button.secondary: rounded-none bg-transparent text-[#1A1A1A] px-8 py-4 font-mono text-sm tracking-widest uppercase border border-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200

dossier_card.wrapper: border border-[#1A1A1A]/20 bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm relative p-8 md:p-12
dossier_card.tab: absolute -top-3 left-8 bg-[#F4F1ED] px-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#1A1A1A]/60 uppercase tracking-widest

stamps.confidential: text-[#7A2021] border-2 border-[#7A2021] px-3 py-1 font-mono text-xl md:text-2xl uppercase tracking-widest rotate-[-5deg] inline-block opacity-80 mix-blend-multiply

images.instructions: Use as a fixed background overlay with low opacity (10-15%) and mix-blend-multiply to give the entire page a physical paper feel.

images.description: Detailed macro shot of vintage typewriter typebars
images.instructions: Use sparingly as a heavily desaturated, high-contrast black-and-white asset in the hero or 'Problem' section to reinforce the extraction/dossier theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the fonts: IBM Plex Serif (Headings), IBM Plex Sans (Body), IBM Plex Mono (Accents, labels, buttons).
Implement the 'dossier' visual aesthetic using 1px borders (border-[#1A1A1A]/20) heavily to separate sections, create grids, and box content.
Use the paper texture image provided in the media section as a fixed background overlay with opacity-10 and mix-blend-multiply to give physical texture.
Do not add any soft shadows (box-shadow). Use hard borders instead.
Ensure all buttons use mailto links exactly as provided.
Use uppercase monospace tags (e.g., [CLASSIFIED], 01 // THE CHAOS) as overlines for sections.
Implement the typewriter/dossier vibe without it feeling gimmicky; keep padding generous and typography extremely crisp.
Build the application using React (.js/.jsx extensions) and TailwindCSS. Do not use TypeScript.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements as mapped in the blueprint.
